nrqlQuery.query: SELECT uniques(hourBegin) FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE component LIKE 'af.%' SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 10

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(sappo.messages.total) AS 'Total' FROM Metric
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.success) AS 'Successful' FROM Metric
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.systemError) AS 'System Errors' FROM Metric
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.waiting) AS 'Waiting' FROM Metric
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.errorRate) AS 'Error Rate %' FROM Metric
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.processing) AS 'Processing', latest(sappo.messages.cancelled) AS 'Cancelled' FROM Metric

SELECT latest(successCount) AS 'Success', latest(systemErrorCount) AS 'System Error', latest(waitingCount) AS 'Waiting', latest(processingCount) AS 'Processing', latest(cancelledCount) AS 'Cancelled' FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE component LIKE 'af.%' AND ({{hourBegin}} = '' OR hourBegin = {{hourBegin}})
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.errorRate) AS 'Error Rate %' FROM Metric TIMESERIES 5 minutes
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.total) AS 'Total', latest(sappo.messages.error) AS 'Errors', latest(sappo.messages.waiting) AS 'Waiting' FROM Metric TIMESERIES 5 minutes
SELECT latest(totalCount) AS 'Messages' FROM SapPoMessageFlow FACET interfaceName LIMIT 15
SELECT latest(systemErrorCount) AS 'Errors' FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE systemErrorCount > 0 FACET interfaceName LIMIT 15

SELECT latest(totalCount) AS 'Total', latest(successCount) AS 'Success', latest(systemErrorCount) AS 'Errors', latest(waitingCount) AS 'Waiting', latest(processingCount) AS 'Processing', latest(cancelledCount) AS 'Cancelled', latest(hourBegin) AS 'SAP Hour', latest(interfaceNamespace) AS 'Namespace' FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE component LIKE 'af.%' AND ({{hourBegin}} = '' OR hourBegin = {{hourBegin}}) FACET senderComponent, receiverComponent, interfaceName LIMIT 100 ORDER BY latest(totalCount) DESC
SELECT latest(systemErrorCount) AS 'Errors' FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE systemErrorCount > 0 FACET senderComponent, interfaceName LIMIT 20
SELECT latest(waitingCount) AS 'Waiting' FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE waitingCount > 0 FACET senderComponent, interfaceName LIMIT 20
SELECT latest(systemErrorCount) FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE systemErrorCount > 0 FACET senderComponent LIMIT 20
SELECT latest(sappo.messages.errorRate) AS 'Error Rate %', latest(sappo.messages.systemError) AS 'System Errors' FROM Metric TIMESERIES 5 minutes

SELECT latest(systemErrorCount) AS 'Errors', latest(waitingCount) AS 'Waiting', latest(totalCount) AS 'Total' FROM SapPoMessageFlow WHERE systemErrorCount > 0 OR waitingCount > 0 FACET interfaceName, senderComponent LIMIT 50

SELECT messageGuid, status, interfaceName, errorCategory, errorText, senderComponent, receiverComponent, processingTimeMs, retries, timesFailed FROM SapPoMessage WHERE isError = true OR status IN ('WAITING','HOLDING','TO_BE_DELIVERED') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT max(sappo.messages.total) AS 'Total', max(sappo.messages.success) AS 'Success', max(sappo.messages.error) AS 'Errors', max(sappo.messages.waiting) AS 'Waiting' FROM Metric TIMESERIES 1 hour
SELECT max(sappo.messages.error) AS 'Peak Errors' FROM Metric TIMESERIES 1 hour
SELECT max(sappo.messages.errorRate) AS 'Error Rate %' FROM Metric TIMESERIES 1 hour
SELECT latest(totalCount) FROM SapPoMessageFlow FACET interfaceName TIMESERIES 5 minutes LIMIT 10
